title: Experts disagree on recordOverride in runtime/claude-plugin/mod/register.tsx
context:
Chief architect: The two claims do not really pull apart: paqadProgram at line 412 is a hoisted top-level function that returns null when the path is missing and has no PATH fallback, so reusing it, as the architect asks, delivers this rule with no new helper. It reaches the owner only because a must-level security finding is always the owner's decision. Recommend the security rule, implemented through paqadProgram.

Target: recordOverride in runtime/claude-plugin/mod/register.tsx
- security-auditor: Allow once may start only the program resolved from $.plugin.root: when that path is missing it records nothing, keeps the deny, and never falls back to a bare paqad-ai looked up on PATH.
- application-architect: Goes through the existing paqadProgram function, with no second path helper. It is a top-level function declaration at line 412, so it needs no move and the diff stays small.
